commandList.name: Lost Mine of Phandelver
rules: Cave Entrance — When you enter this room, scry 1. (Leads to Goblin Lair or Mine Tunnels)
ICON_DUNGEON_ROOM_CURRENTGoblin Lair — When you enter this room, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token. (Leads to Storeroom or Dark Pool)
Mine Tunnels — When you enter this room, create a Treasure token. (Leads to Dark Pool or Fungi Cavern)
ICON_DUNGEON_ROOM_NEXTStoreroom — When you enter this room, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. (Leads to Temple of Dumathoin)
ICON_DUNGEON_ROOM_NEXTDark Pool — When you enter this room, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life. (Leads to Temple of Dumathoin)
Fungi Cavern — When you enter this room, target creature gets -4/-0 until your next turn. (Leads to Temple of Dumathoin)
Temple of Dumathoin — When you enter this room, draw a card.

a8a1dcb5-908e-41db-8089-b891c9d8b3dd.name: Radiation
rules: At the beginning of each player's precombat main phase, if that player has one or more rad counters, mill that many cards. For each nonland card milled this way, you lose 1 life and remove one rad counter.
